chapters.label: Wembley, full time
chapters.text: Wembley, 2025, the League Cup final. The whistle blows! Newcastle beat Liverpool, two goals to one.

chapters.label: The trophy
chapters.text: Their captain, Bruno Guimarães, lifts the trophy with Kieran Trippier. The fans had waited seventy years for an English cup!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How he does it: Bruno wins the ball back. Then, before anything else, he looks forward. A teammate is running! One quick pass, and his team is attacking.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! After you win the ball, look forward first, for a quick pass.
